example_sentence: Did you see that guy at the party? He was zonked!

slang_definition: an unexpected and usually undesirable kiss.
example_sentence: She pulled a zoom-in on me last night.

slang_definition: a furry costume; "fursuit".  From the "furry" subculture.
example_sentence: I'm getting a new wolf zoot.
I'm so zooted.

slang_definition: suffix used with a word to intensify it.  Frequently used in collaboration with (and originated from) "leet speak" (1337).  Also -zorness, -zors.
example_sentence: wowzors!
I can't find my zories.
I was zosted last night.
Zounds!  What a nice bike!

slang_definition: sleep.  Used in expressions such as catch some z's, get some z's.
example_sentence: I'm gonna catch some z's.  I'll call you later.
He left a picture of his zubra on my phone.

slang_definition: a rope swing next to a body of water (such as a river or swimming pool.)
example_sentence: Let's go swing on the zunga.

slang_definition: The study of beer and beer-making, including the role particular ingredients play in the brewing process.  A zythologist is a student and connoisseur of beer who possess knowledge of ingredients, pouring techniques and beer pairings.  From Greek zythos (beer) + logos (study).
example_sentence: The waiter won't know which beer to pair with a roasted rack of lamb.  I've been studying zythology and I think you should have the lager.
